## Summary

I implemented architecture-aware `xcrun` invocation so Apple developer tools run natively on Apple Silicon (arm64) Macs rather than under Rosetta.

**`lib/src/macos/xcode.dart`**
- Added `import '../base/os.dart'` and an `OperatingSystemUtils` dependency to the `Xcode` constructor.
- Added `xcrunCommand()`, which returns `['/usr/bin/arch', '-arm64', 'xcrun']` on arm64 macOS and `['xcrun']` otherwise. It delegates arm64 detection to `OperatingSystemUtils.hostPlatform` (which runs `sysctl hw.optional.arm64` and checks for exit code 0 + stdout ending in `1`).
- Routed `eulaSigned`, `isSimctlInstalled`, `cc`, `clang`, and `sdkLocation` through `xcrunCommand()`.
- `XCDevice.isInstalled` now returns `_xcode.isInstalledAndMeetsVersionCheck`; removed the `xcdevicePath` property and its `xcrun --find xcdevice` call. `xcdevice list`/`observe` now use `_xcode.xcrunCommand()`.
- `isInstalledAndMeetsVersionCheck` already short-circuits on non-macOS (`_platform.isMacOS && …`), satisfying the no-extra-process-call requirement.

**`lib/src/ios/simulators.dart`**
- `SimControl` now takes a required `xcode` parameter; all `simctl` operations (list, isInstalled/get_app_container, install, uninstall, launch, takeScreenshot, spawn) use `_xcode.xcrunCommand()`. Removed the `_xcrunPath` constant and the unused `xcrunPath` getter.

**`lib/src/ios/mac.dart`**, **`lib/src/build_system/targets/ios.dart`**, **`lib/src/commands/build_ios_framework.dart`**
- All `xcodebuild` and `lipo` invocations (build pipeline, stub framework creation, plugin/xcframework builds) now use `...globals.xcode.xcrunCommand()`.

I did not touch anything under `tests/`, and left `build_macos.dart` (macOS, out of the iOS scope) unchanged, consistent with the reference PR.
